CHI.name: Jalen Smith
CHI.detail: Smith (finger) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against Minnesota, K.C. Johnson of Chicago Sports Network reports.

CHI.name: Nic Claxton
CHI.detail: Claxton (hamstring) is out for Saturday's game against the Timberwolves, K.C. Johnson of Chicago Sports Network reports.

CHI.name: Tobe Awaka
CHI.detail: Awaka has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Timberwolves.

CHI.name: Caleb Wilson
CHI.detail: Wilson (hand) is expected to miss four to six weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

CLE.name: Peyton Watson
CLE.detail: Watson (hamstring) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Mavericks.

CLE.name: James Harden
CLE.detail: Harden (calf) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against Dallas.

CLE.name: Donovan Mitchell
CLE.detail: Mitchell (knee) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Mavericks.

CLE.name: Jarrett Allen
CLE.detail: Allen (knee) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Mavericks.

CLE.name: Evan Mobley
CLE.detail: Mobley (toe) has been ruled out for Saturday's meeting with Dallas.

CLE.name: Sam Merrill
CLE.detail: Merrill (elbow) is listed as out for Wednesday's game against the Knicks.

CLE.name: Nae'Qwan Tomlin
CLE.detail: Tomlin is set to miss several weeks with a lower back stress reaction, Chris Fedor of The Cleveland Plain Dealer reports.

DEN.name: Julian Strawther
DEN.detail: Strawther (knee) was diagnosed with a left knee sprain Friday and will be re-evaluated in six weeks, Vinny Benedetto of The Denver Gazette reports.

DET.name: Ugonna Onyenso
DET.detail: Onyenso agreed to a two-way contract with the Pistons on Thursday.

DET.name: Isaiah Joe
DET.detail: Joe (hip) is out for Monday against the Wizards.

DET.name: Jalen Duren
DET.detail: Duren (hamstring) has begun on-court activity and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Hunter Patterson of The Athletic reports.

GS.name: Stephen Curry
GS.detail: Curry has been diagnosed with an oblique abdominal tear and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

GS.name: Brandon Williams
GS.detail: Williams (hamstring) will miss at least one week, per Anthony Slater of ESPN.com.

GS.name: Kristaps Porzingis
GS.detail: Porzingis announced on his social media that he's stepping away from basketball.

GS.name: Moses Moody
GS.detail: Moody (knee) is progressing toward a potential return between December and January after rupturing his left patellar tendon in March, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

GS.name: Jimmy Butler III
GS.detail: Butler (knee) could return sometime between January and February as he continues recovering from a torn right ACL, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

MEM.name: Zach Edey
MEM.detail: Edey (ankle) is listed as out for Saturday's game against the Nets.

MEM.name: Jerami Grant
MEM.detail: Grant (head) is out for Saturday's game against the Nets.

MEM.name: Quinten Post
MEM.detail: Post (concussion) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Nets.

MEM.name: Ty Jerome
MEM.detail: Jerome (hip) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Nets.

MEM.name: Scotty Pippen Jr.
MEM.detail: Pippen (back) remains out for Wednesday's game against Denver, Michael Wallace of the Grizzlies' official site reports.

MEM.name: Richie Saunders
MEM.detail: Saunders signed a two-way contract with the Grizzlies on Saturday, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

MIA.name: Pelle Larsson
MIA.detail: Larsson (illness) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Pistons.

MIN.name: Anthony Edwards
MIN.detail: Edwards underwent a successful arthroscopic procedure on his right knee Thursday, the Timberwolves announced.

MIN.name: Donte DiVincenzo
MIN.detail: DiVincenzo (Achilles) remains confident that he'll return during the 2026-27 season, Jon Krawczynski of The Athletic reports.

NO.name: Bennedict Mathurin
NO.detail: Mathurin is out for Saturday's game against the Nuggets due to left plantar fasciitis.

NO.name: Trendon Watford
NO.detail: Watford (ankle) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against Denver.

NO.name: Bryce McGowens
NO.detail: McGowens (elbow) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Nuggets.

NO.name: Trey Murphy III
NO.detail: Murphy (knees) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Nuggets.

NO.name: Dejounte Murray
NO.detail: Murray (ankle) is out for Friday's game against Memphis.

ORL.name: Noah Penda
ORL.detail: Penda (hamstring) is making progress but remains without a timetable to return to game action, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.

ORL.name: Jonathan Isaac
ORL.detail: Isaac (knee) is out for Tuesday's game against Sacramento.

ORL.name: Paolo Banchero
ORL.detail: Banchero is expected to be sidelined for the next four-to-six weeks due to a right high-ankle sprain, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

ORL.name: Izaiyah Nelson
ORL.detail: Team president Jeff Weltman said Monday that Nelson (ankle) remains about a month away from returning to the court after offseason surgery, per Philip Rossman-Reich of OrlandoMagicDaily.com.

POR.name: Chris Youngblood
POR.detail: Youngblood (foot) is out for Friday's game against Sacramento.

POR.name: Vit Krejci
POR.detail: Krejci underwent surgery on his fractured left ankle Wednesday and will be re-evaluated in eight weeks, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

POR.name: Ja Morant
POR.detail: Head coach Micah Nori said Morant met with a doctor in Los Angeles, who gave him a positive outlook on his recovery from the hamstring injury. While Nori declined to update Morant's timetable, he added Morant "may not be out for as long as we thought," Trail Blazers Insider Sean Highkin reports.

POR.name: Shaedon Sharpe
POR.detail: Sharpe suffered a torn meniscus in his knee and is expected to miss six months, per Shams Charania of ESPN.
